name: Spaceship b3726ba1 on the 2-uniform tiling k2-015
description: A period-44 spaceship on the 2-uniform tiling k2-015 (touching neighbours), 11 to 16 cells, moving one lattice step every 44 generations (c/44). It runs the same way in the 16 rules from B4,5,6,7,8,10/S56 to B4,5,6,7,8,10,11,12/S0,5,6,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Its live cells evolve the same way on k3-015 and k3-021, where the empty tiles around them have other neighbour counts, and on k3-052. JETCARP's soup search found it on k3-021 (seen 35 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
